Content.SourceString: DSD有绘莉圆舞曲系列的主题快闪，怎么样，有没有兴趣？
Content.LocalizedString: There's a pop-up event at DSD with the theme of Ellie's Gala series. Interested?

Content.SourceString: 正好没事做，难得真红主动约人出去玩，当然要去。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course I'm going. I'm not busy, and it's rare that you invite someone out.

Content.SourceString: 没想到真红会主动约人出去玩，那我可不能错过。
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't think you'd ask someone out. I won't miss this opportunity.

Content.SourceString: 其实是想找你帮个忙，你这样整得我怪……
Content.LocalizedString: I have a little favor to ask, but if you…

Content.SourceString: 总之见面聊吧，我在鹤径北的DSD等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet up. I'll wait for you at the DSD on the northside of Crane Path!

Content.SourceString: 总之见面聊吧，我在鹤径北的DSD等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet up. I'll wait for you at the DSD on the northside of Crane Path!

Content.SourceString: 有空来我家一趟吗？有件事我拿不定主意，想征求下你的意见。
Content.LocalizedString: Can you come to my place when you're available? I need your take on something.

Content.SourceString: 没问题，我这就过去。
Content.LocalizedString: Got it. I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 暂时有些事，可能要晚点。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm occupied right now. Maybe later.

Content.SourceString: 有空的话直接过来就好，我在家里等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Just come over when you're available. I'll be waiting at my place.

Content.SourceString: 有空的话直接过来就好，我在家里等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Just come over when you're available. I'll be waiting at my place.

Content.SourceString: 最近有时间吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have some time?

Content.SourceString: 今天就有，要出来玩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm available today. Do you want to hang out?

Content.SourceString: 正好我今天也休息，让我想想有什么地方……
Content.LocalizedString: I have a day off too. Let me think about a place…

Content.SourceString: 有了，愿木坡见，怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: Right. How about we meet at Yuanmu Hill?

Content.SourceString: 不见不散。
Content.LocalizedString: Be there or be square.

Content.SourceString: 不见不散。
Content.LocalizedString: Be there or be square.

Content.SourceString: 你觉得上次薄荷找我们玩的游戏怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you think of the game Mint asked us to play last time?

Content.SourceString: 像是去了一个全新的世界，很奇妙的体验。
Content.LocalizedString: It's like I went to a brand new world. It felt amazing.

Content.SourceString: 虽然现实时间没过多久，但在异象空间里却经过了好几天，还是会有些累。
Content.LocalizedString: Though not much time passed in the real world, it felt like days in the Anomalous Realm, so I'm a bit tired.

Content.SourceString: 我也有差不多的感觉。就算是异象制品，未免也太真实了……
Content.LocalizedString: Same here. It felt way too real for an anomaly product.

Content.SourceString: 后来我又去了DSD好几次，但是典藏版的「九百九十九夜」动不动就售罄无货，结果我没忍住又买了好些其他的。
Content.LocalizedString: I went to DSD a couple of times after, but the 999 Nights collector's edition was always sold out. I ended up buying many other stuff.

Content.SourceString: ……回过神来就已经在家里堆了一柜子。
Content.LocalizedString: Before I realized… my place was full of boxes and packages.

Content.SourceString: 这么受欢迎吗？
Content.LocalizedString: It's that popular?

Content.SourceString: 搭配「城主骰子」的「九百九十九夜」大概是现在最热门的桌游了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: 999 Nights with Dice Lord is probably the most popular board game right now.

Content.SourceString: 除了我们玩的，还有「炽风谷」和「浅滩城」这样广受好评的剧本。
Content.LocalizedString: Apart from the story we played, Emberwind Valley and Tidemark City are also popular stories.

Content.SourceString: ……但奇怪的是，翻了那么多条呗果，跟我们的经历类似的人一个也没有。
Content.LocalizedString: The strange thing is… I dug through many posts on Bagel, but couldn't find anyone who had played the same thing.

Content.SourceString: 真想知道薄荷到底是从哪搞来的这个。
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder where in Hethereau Mint got them in the first place.

Content.SourceString: 要不……问问薄荷？
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't you… just ask her?

Content.SourceString: 或许有什么设定能触发隐藏剧本，被我们误打误撞碰上了？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe something triggered a secret story, and we happened to meet the conditions?

Content.SourceString: 如果有那么容易就好了……大笨猫只记得一直放在家里，什么时候和从哪儿买的一概都想不起来。
Content.LocalizedString: If it was as simple as that… Dumcat only remembered she'd left them at home. She doesn't recall where and when she got them.

Content.SourceString: 与其说是隐藏剧本……我觉得更像是量身定制的。
Content.LocalizedString: Instead of a secret story… the game felt more customized.

Content.SourceString: 明明是从来没听过的版本，本来还想入手收藏的……
Content.LocalizedString: The edition is unheard of. I wanted to buy one myself…

Content.SourceString: ……比如那个神秘商绵。太可疑了，没准是有谁在捣鬼。
Content.LocalizedString: For example, that Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant was too sus. It was almost like someone was messing with us.

Content.SourceString: 至少大家都玩得很开心，这就够啦。
Content.LocalizedString: At least everyone had fun. That's the most important thing.

Content.SourceString: 确实，毕竟是游戏，只要大家开心就没问题……
Content.LocalizedString: Right. It's a game after all. Fun is all we need…

Content.SourceString: 不过有人费尽心思送上这么独特的体验，怎么能不去表达一下感谢呢？
Content.LocalizedString: But since someone went to great lengths to let us experience such a unique world, am I not obligated to thank them?

Content.SourceString: 微笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: smile.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我最近对一件事很感兴趣。
Content.LocalizedString: I've been curious about something.

Content.SourceString: 什么事，说来听听。
Content.LocalizedString: What's that? Tell me about it.

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达的叫声。
Content.LocalizedString: Nacupeda's calls.

Content.SourceString: 应该有挺多人都听过来着？
Content.LocalizedString: Many people should have heard it, right?

Content.SourceString: 「嗯嗯！」
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm! Mhm!

Content.SourceString: ……是啊，跟那副悠哉悠哉的模样倒是很般配。
Content.LocalizedString: …Yeah, goes really well with that carefree look of Nacupeda.

Content.SourceString: 但是呗果上有那么多人都在传说「真的能心想事成」或是「偷偷捞走许愿池里的硬币会被雷劈」……
Content.LocalizedString: But so many people on Bagel spread rumors like "wishes really do come true" or "if you steal coins out of the wishing pool, you'll get struck by lightning"…

Content.SourceString: 作为一个这么特别的异象，不觉得他的叫声太普通了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: For such a unique anomaly, don't you think Nacupeda's call is too ordinary?

Content.SourceString: 有种敷衍人的感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Almost half-hearted.

Content.SourceString: 是有点这意思。
Content.LocalizedString: I can see that.

Content.SourceString: 不过！据说那只大白耗子也有很少被人听到的稀有款叫声——在他生气的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: That said! I heard that a few people actually heard that white rodent make a rare sound—when Nacupeda is angry.

Content.SourceString: 你能想象那是种什么样的叫声吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can you imagine what that sound is?

Content.SourceString: 我连纳库佩达生气的样子都想象不出来。是因为发生了特别的状况吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I can't even imagine Nacupeda getting angry. Was there something special that happened?

Content.SourceString: 大概是种值得收藏起来的声音？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe they want to keep that sound to themselves?

Content.SourceString: 这就是奇怪的地方了。
Content.LocalizedString: That's where things get strange.

Content.SourceString: 我为什么要保留一只大白耗子生气时的动静……
Content.LocalizedString: Why would I even want to keep the angry sounds of a white rodent a secret…

Content.SourceString: 不少人信誓旦旦地附和说真的有，但一问到底发生了什么，他们就开始闪烁其词。
Content.LocalizedString: Many people claim that the rare call really exists, but when they're asked about what happened, they start to stammer.

Content.SourceString: 而且叫声要怎么收藏……难不成录下来？
Content.LocalizedString: How am I supposed to keep that sound… do I have to record it?

Content.SourceString: 好像也不是不行。
Content.LocalizedString: That could work.

Content.SourceString: 那问题就变成了：纳库佩达怎么才会生气呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So the problem becomes: how does Nacupeda get angry?

Content.SourceString: 那些人肯定做了些什么不光彩的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Those people must have done something wrong.

Content.SourceString: 比如去捞许愿池里的硬币……
Content.LocalizedString: Such as scavenging coins from the wishing pool…

Content.SourceString: 要确认的话，只能亲自去试一下了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: For the sake of science, why don't you try it yourself?

Content.SourceString: ……敬谢不敏。
Content.LocalizedString: …I'll pass.

Content.SourceString: 有没有什么能让人快速提升记忆力的办法？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there some easy way to boost one's memory?

Content.SourceString: 怎么忽然考虑这些事情？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you looking into this?

Content.SourceString: 是薄荷又做什么了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What did Mint do this time?

Content.SourceString: 是那只笨猫……
Content.LocalizedString: It's that dumcat…

Content.SourceString: 看来那只笨猫在这方面还真是有口皆碑。
Content.LocalizedString: I see that dumcat does have a reputation when it comes to this.

Content.SourceString: 昨天我们接日常执勤，出外勤。
Content.LocalizedString: We were on a routine field mission yesterday.

Content.SourceString: 也是常有的事情，我跟天线羊很快就赶过去了，结果到那等半天都等不来薄荷。
Content.LocalizedString: Just the usual. Ramtenna and I arrived on site promptly, but Mint was very late.

Content.SourceString: 联系到她说是有重要的东西找不到了，让我们等她一下，很快就到。
Content.LocalizedString: When we contacted her, she said something important was gone, so she asked us to wait a bit.

Content.SourceString: 忽然忘了东西放在哪，找不到了，这也很正常吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Forgetting something isn't something out of the ordinary, is it?

Content.SourceString: 如果只是找不到东西我就不会来找你吐槽了。
Content.LocalizedString: If it were as simple as that, I wouldn't be venting here.

Content.SourceString: 因为任务比较简单嘛，我跟天线羊就直接解决了，回到管理局后发现薄荷还在找。
Content.LocalizedString: The mission was an easy one, so Ramtenna and I wrapped it up ourselves. But when we went back to the Bureau, Mint was still looking for the thing.

Content.SourceString: 既然如此，那就帮她找找吧？
Content.LocalizedString: I guess you helped her look for it?

Content.SourceString: 找这么久，总不会是弄丢了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: She looked for a long time. Did she lose it?

Content.SourceString: 我们也是这么想的。
Content.LocalizedString: That's what we were going to do.

Content.SourceString: ……不过这样也没必要跟我说了。
Content.LocalizedString: …but then you wouldn't be venting to me.

Content.SourceString: 我们问她在找什么，你绝对猜不到她的回答。
Content.LocalizedString: We asked what she was looking for. You're never going to guess it.

Content.SourceString: 饭卡？
Content.LocalizedString: Meal plan certificate?

Content.SourceString: 工牌？
Content.LocalizedString: Her badge?

Content.SourceString: 收容单元？
Content.LocalizedString: A containment unit?

Content.SourceString: 她站起来，手里拿着手机对我们说：
Content.LocalizedString: She stood up, with phone in hand, and told us…

Content.SourceString: 不好意思啊果果茶茶，我的手机找不到了！一着急就忘了时间，晚上请你们吃饭！
Content.LocalizedString: "Sorry, Taya and Teana, I can't find my phone! I was lost in time looking for it. Dinner's on me!"

Content.SourceString: 所以说啊……
Content.LocalizedString: So…

Content.SourceString: 等等，有人找我有事。
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, someone's looking for me.

Content.SourceString: 真红，解决了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Shinku, you good?

Content.SourceString: 等下跟你说，我手机找不到了。
Content.LocalizedString: A moment. I can't find my phone.

Content.SourceString: 对方已下线。
Content.LocalizedString: (User is offline)

Content.SourceString: 啧，我在追的一部漫画作者出意外了。
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, a manga artist I'm following got into an accident.

Content.SourceString: 那岂不是有可能看不到后续了？
Content.LocalizedString: Will they cancel the manga?

Content.SourceString: 什么漫画？
Content.LocalizedString: What manga?

Content.SourceString: 倒不至于，现在看来还是有康复的风险的。
Content.LocalizedString: That shouldn't happen. The author is at the risk of a full recovery.

Content.SourceString: 为了我的良心不受谴责，你还是不知道比较好。
Content.LocalizedString: For the sake of my conscience, it's better that you don't know.

Content.SourceString: 何出此言？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you mean?

Content.SourceString: 这么夸张吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Is it that bad…?

Content.SourceString: 这作者的水平是真不错，但最近越来越放飞自我了。
Content.LocalizedString: The author is very talented, but they've been letting themself go.

Content.SourceString: 随心所欲地让高人气角色退场，又临时决定把他们复活。
Content.LocalizedString: Popular characters were killed randomly just to be casually revived.

Content.SourceString: 不感兴趣的地方桥段就不顾前后矛盾和剧情降智草草带过……
Content.LocalizedString: They rush through arcs they aren't interested in with contradictions and the plot gets dumber by each episode…

Content.SourceString: 又会在莫名其妙的地方添加用心到不正常的大量篇幅。
Content.LocalizedString: Not to mention they add weirdly excessive details to the most random places.

Content.SourceString: 要不是作画还是一如既往地优秀，我都怀疑是不是同一个人在连载。
Content.LocalizedString: If the art wasn't still as great, I'd swear it's a different person drawing the manga.

Content.SourceString: 烂透了。
Content.LocalizedString: It sucks so much.

Content.SourceString: 懂你意思，就是会有这种忽然……失去理智的作者。
Content.LocalizedString: I feel you. Some authors really… go bonkers and lose their minds.

Content.SourceString: 追连载，踩雷才是日常。
Content.LocalizedString: That happens a lot when you read the latest releases.

Content.SourceString: 好了不要再说了，我已经知道你也是有故事的人了……
Content.LocalizedString: That's enough. I already can tell that the same has happened to you…

Content.SourceString: 没准我们在说的都是同一部作品。
Content.LocalizedString: We might even be talking about the same manga.

Content.SourceString: 唉，有时候就会想，如果作者在剧情最高峰的时候封笔，虽然没有结局但也能给人美好的想象空间——
Content.LocalizedString: Sigh. Sometimes I think what would happen when the author quits at the manga's peak. There'd be no ending, but much room left for imagination.

Content.SourceString: 结果到现在，大家知道了只能问一句「还有康复风险吗？」，真是……
Content.LocalizedString: At this point, fans are only asking whether "the author is at the risk of a full recovery"… It's sad…

OptionText.SourceString: 不如停在最美好的时候
OptionText.LocalizedString: I prefer it to stop at its peak

Content.SourceString: 就算是烂尾，至少也有一段正式的结束，可以向这部作品告别了……
Content.LocalizedString: An ending is an ending, even when it's bad. At least you can say goodbye and move on…

Content.SourceString: 的确，一部作品如果能停在最美好的时候那最好了。
Content.LocalizedString: You're right. A manga is best when it stops at its peak.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟，实在不行还可以将结局切割分开来看。
Content.LocalizedString: If you must, you can still separate the ending from everything else.

Content.SourceString: 这样的话，留下的就是最棒的回忆。
Content.LocalizedString: That way, you'll remember the best of it.

Content.SourceString: 倒也是。
Content.LocalizedString: Fair point.

Content.SourceString: 有些遗憾，印象也会更深。
Content.LocalizedString: Although it's a shame, it'd leave a more lasting impression.

Content.SourceString: 你平时会去钓鱼吗，鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you fish?

Content.SourceString: 我最近刚开始尝试……这比想象中有意思。
Content.LocalizedString: I started fishing recently… It's more fun than I imagined.

Content.SourceString: 作为打发时间的消遣来说，意外地还挺不错。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a surprisingly good way to pass the time.

Content.SourceString: 为什么会想到要钓鱼呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Why did you start fishing?

Content.SourceString: 都有些什么收获？
Content.LocalizedString: What did you catch?

Content.SourceString: 如果只是坐在海边晒太阳，很难保证不会有人来打扰。
Content.LocalizedString: If I were sitting by the sea, basking in the sun, people could still bother me.

Content.SourceString: 很漂亮的鹦鹉螺和鱼鳞金币……
Content.LocalizedString: Nautili and Scale Coins…

Content.SourceString: 但如果我拿着钓竿，有常识的人一般就不会靠过来了。
Content.LocalizedString: But with a fishing rod in hand, those with some common sense wouldn't approach.

Content.SourceString: 对了，还有一对「特工Z世代」的特别款应援棒——我从来都不知道钓鱼还能钓到这些东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I also caught a pair of special edition support sticks for Gen Z. I didn't even think that was possible.

Content.SourceString: 居然是这种原因吗？
Content.LocalizedString: That's the reason?

Content.SourceString: 我也不知道……
Content.LocalizedString: Neither did I…

Content.SourceString: 只是手握钓竿，各种纷扰就会自然退去。
Content.LocalizedString: When I hold the fishing rod, all of my thoughts melt away.

Content.SourceString: ……这就是资深钓客们的心境吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is that what long-time fishers feel?

Content.SourceString: 说的话已经很有垂钓大师的气魄了呢。
Content.LocalizedString: You already sound like a Master Angler.

Content.SourceString: 其实是晒着太阳快睡着了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: She'll fall asleep if she does that.

Content.SourceString: 倒也不用捧场到这个份上……不过确实可以拉其他人也来试试。
Content.LocalizedString: You don't need to say that… but I do think I could try having others join me.

Content.SourceString: 咻啪吃惊2.gif
Content.LocalizedString: Chuppa_surprised_2.gif

Content.SourceString: 尤其是薄荷，这次一定要让她老老实实坐上半个小时。
Content.LocalizedString: Especially Mint. I'm going to make her sit still for over half an hour.

Content.SourceString: ……鱼竿差点掉进海里了。
Content.LocalizedString: …My rod almost fell into the sea.

Content.SourceString: 又一次……
Content.LocalizedString: It happened again…

Content.SourceString: 等完漫长的演职员名单之后，却发现根本没有彩蛋。
Content.LocalizedString: I sat through the ending credits just to find out that there were no easter eggs.

Content.SourceString: 明明已经官宣了续集，怎么一点钓人胃口的预告铺垫或者花絮都没有。
Content.LocalizedString: They already announced the sequel, so why didn't they feed the audience any bait or bloopers?

Content.SourceString: 太让人失望了。
Content.LocalizedString: My disappointment is immeasurable.

Content.SourceString: 如果没有彩蛋的话，影院工作人员应该都会在正片结束的时候来通知来着？
Content.LocalizedString: Once the movie ends, don't theater staff usually tell people whether there will be easter eggs or not?

Content.SourceString: 现在好像越来越流行把片尾彩蛋这种小片段当做正式的宣传放在各种媒体上展示了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's a trend to release easter eggs on other platforms as a marketing ploy.

Content.SourceString: ……有倒是有。
Content.LocalizedString: They did…

Content.SourceString: 虽然不是不能理解……
Content.LocalizedString: I get that…

Content.SourceString: 但只要电影自己没标注「没有片尾彩蛋」，我都会忍不住等到字幕滚动结束……
Content.LocalizedString: But if the movie itself doesn't say that "there are no easter eggs," I usually can't stop myself from watching the credits roll.

Content.SourceString: 但就不能给那些来现场观影的人多一些惊喜和小奖励吗？
Content.LocalizedString: …but can't they save some surprises to reward those who actually went to the movie?

Content.SourceString: 而且就算真的没有彩蛋，也能自我安慰是尊重电影的制作团队，对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Even if there aren't any easter eggs, you're still showing respect to the crew that made the movie, right?

Content.SourceString: 毕竟能吸引到更多的人，这样的做法慢慢变成主流也是正常的啦。
Content.LocalizedString: They're able to get more people to watch the movie that way. It makes sense that such approaches have become mainstream.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷wewantyou无字扩散.gif
Content.LocalizedString: Mint_wewantyou_unlimited_expansion.gif

Content.SourceString: 是这个道理……
Content.LocalizedString: Fair point…

Content.SourceString: ——哦！呗果上还真的有官方发布的续作制作花絮。
Content.LocalizedString: Oho! They really released some behind-the-scenes clips on their official Bagel account.

Content.SourceString: 但是……
Content.LocalizedString: But…

Content.SourceString: 但是怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: But what?

Content.SourceString: 续作怎么看着好像……放着之前的悬念和伏笔不管，一转开启了另一段故事。
Content.LocalizedString: But it looks like the sequel… ignores all the cliffhangers and setups from before, then blatantly begins a brand new arc.

Content.SourceString: 这下更失望了。
Content.LocalizedString: And my day is ruined.
